capabilities: JAX state-space filtering and parameter learning
limitation: Statistical state models need separate controlled causal identification
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Discrete-time emission sequences, optional external inputs and initial/transition/emission parameter components.
scientific_qualification.output: Conditional emission log likelihood, filtering/smoothing distributions and parameter-fitting ingredients.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: The specified conditional-input SSM matches the observational experiment; treating adaptive actions as inputs requires a valid logger/conditioning argument.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: HMM marginal_log_prob builds initial, transition and emission factors only. A private action likelihood is not supplied automatically. Standard transition components may ignore inputs; qualify the actual subclass and index mapping. Keep filtering separate from smoothing.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare finite latent-path summation to filter likelihood; include an informative private logger and demonstrate failure of a transition/emission-only likelihood. Verify input and observation timing explicitly.

evidence.finding: HMM law, optional input components, marginal_log_prob, filter, smoother and E-step.

pinned_api_revision.scope: Inspected API files at this commit; not an assertion about all README bytes or the published package release.
